improvements.title: El retorno de actualización debe separar filas coincidentes, cambios y una operación sin cambios permitida
improvements.condition: La política TO-BE admite repetir una operación ya satisfecha o guardar valores idénticos. La configuración del cliente SQL puede informar cambios o coincidencias; esa configuración no se ha comprobado.
improvements.observation: El modelo de una sentencia exitosa con fila existente y valores ya iguales produce cero cambios. Un arreglo que traduce affected_rows==0 a inexistencia o error rechaza ese éxito permitido. La condición no debe confundirse con una fila que no coincide o no está autorizada.
improvements.proposed_rule_TO_BE: Definir resultados distintos para CHANGED, NOOP_CONFIRMED si la política lo permite, NOT_FOUND y rechazo de transición. Fijar qué cuenta el cliente SQL; combinar predicado autorizado y estado observado para distinguirlos. Si la política no permite no-op, devolver ese resultado específico sin inferir inexistencia.
improvements.novelty: La mejora aceptada CLR-IMP-001 limitaba la afirmación de pérdida tras DELETE; esta pasada contrasta una reparación basada en conteos con una actualización/no-op exitosa y exige un contrato de retorno más preciso.
improvements.dedup_rationale: Mejora de reparación/contrato dentro de IDs existentes; no otro defecto OPS ni una política de idempotencia declarada AS-IS.

improvements.title: La reparación de pertenencia debe conservar IDs numéricos válidos recibidos como string
improvements.condition: La representación válida del ID de evento es int26 o string decimal'26'. El tipo concreto devuelto en el despliegue no se ha verificado; la fuente no normaliza antes de la búsqueda.
improvements.observation: Cambiar el if de array_search por pertenencia estricta al entero26 no reconoce '26', aunque representa el mismo ID y la búsqueda previa no estricta lo reconoce. Es una regresión de un caso exitoso de lectura, independiente de la posición o repetición.
improvements.proposed_rule_TO_BE: Comparar el resultado de búsqueda con false estrictamente sin cambiar la igualdad de valores, o validar y normalizar de forma explícita el tipo de ID antes de pertenencia estricta. Conservar int26 y '26'; no convertir indiscriminadamente entradas no numéricas como'26x'.
improvements.novelty: Los probes y la pasada anterior usaban IDs enteros. El contraejemplo exitoso de representación string prueba una obligación de reparación no cubierta por corregir solo índice0 o repeticiones.
improvements.dedup_rationale: Precisión de TO-BE de OPS-006/CLR-IMP-002, no nuevo hallazgo OPS ni confirmación de tipos o eventos reales.

checks.obligation_TO_BE: Preserve operation identity across notifications/other statements; same connection and capture before collaborators.
Conjunction must use a valid neutral element and an explicit empty-list policy; do not initialize an AND reduction with false.
Repair signature and preserve/validate the required description before destructive replacement.
At group commit, processed rows must belong to confirmed groups; report/account/group identity bound.
Identity reconciliation must conserve registered occurrences and pending membership, if repeated event types are allowed.
Membership repair must preserve valid int/string ID representations; strict value equality is not strict search-result comparison.
Recompute totals using an agreed monetary representation/rounding policy, not strict binary-float equality.
Return a defined confirmation contract and choose authorized active order; consume it in caller.
Supply validated intended scope; adding a default null only fixes arity, not selection semantics.
Distinguish required failures from valid optional absence; a raw false may represent no requested route.
Separate matched/changed rows and allowed no-op; affected-row zero alone cannot mean missing/unauthorized.

weak_repair_outcome.if_changed_rows_gt_zero_else_error: error for an allowed unchanged row

checks.obligation_TO_BE: Calendar, format and absence are separate obligations; accepted empty input must not silently become1900.
Classify observed data loss independently from successful DELETE statement and arity error.
Check presence, not truthiness of first matching index; preserve repeated26 condition.
Define return contract before testing it; implicit NULL is not an operation outcome.

technique: counterfactual repair-obligation/discriminating success witnesses; Hoare-style postconditions on proposed TO-BE contracts
limitations: Review bounded to9OPS+6accepted improvements; two further TO-BE proposals, no new OPS IDs or global convergence.
Candidate repairs are logical models, not implemented PHP/SQL changes or approved requirements.
No runtime, query fault injection, MySQL, DB/network, sessions or browser/navigation outputs executed or reviewed.
No universally valid no-op policy, affected-row client flags, actual event-ID representation, timezone or monetary scale inferred.
Counterexamples with successful inputs show insufficiency of a weak repair; satisfying the listed witness is not a proof for all inputs.
Original PHP8 signature probes remain prior evidence; PHP5.4 not executed.
PinP95fe9a4is historical, not latestPeru; observed2a179e2is not audited. No refs changed.
IMP-SCOPE001 belongs to principal; not duplicated as an operational improvement. Ledger not compiled here.

obligation_interpretation: Each completed check constructs a successful input/statement or valid optional/no-op case. Weak repairs are hypothetical, not application changes. Candidate repair predicates satisfy the witness; that is not proof of universal correctness or policy approval.

dedup_decisions.result: Neutral AND identity is a required implementation detail of the already proposed accumulation repair; no separate new finding.
Retain registered occurrence IDs if repetitions allowed; existing repair already requires deciding representation of repetitions.
Binary float equality can reject0.10+0.20, already covered by agreed monetary precision requirement.
NULL success rejection already accepted in pass6; not recounted.
Default null avoids arity but breaks scope selection; existing validated-scope requirement covers it.
Optional absence and separate calendar/absence policy already explicit; useful counterexamples without additional registry IDs.
